facet_definition_changes.format_facts.presentation_modes: Observable presentation modes, not audience approval. Stand_up means a substantial stand-up comedy performance organizes the presentation; concert_performance means a substantial concert or musical performance constitutes the work or a substantial program segment, not simply a scene in a narrative film. Game_show uses a presented contestant game or quiz format, not competition as story subject; talk_show uses a presenter-led conversation/interview program, not documentary interviews alone; variety_show combines hosted entertainment segments. Staged_performance presents a substantial staged theatrical, dance or musical production; opera_performance presents an operatic performance tradition and does not imply Western classical music. Live_puppetry presents physically manipulated puppets performing in real time, not automatically stop-motion or puppet animation. These modes may overlap with each other and documentary modes when independently supported. Depicted toys or performers alone are insufficient.
facet_definition_changes.cultural.movements_and_traditions: Established artistic affiliation or substantial recognizable stylistic tradition. Country, language, slow pacing or production date alone is insufficient. This list is bounded; unlisted traditions require a future schema revision, not a guessed synonym. Bollywood industry affiliation does not establish masala or bollywood_masala style. French_poetic_realism names the established film movement, not any poetic or realistic treatment. New_german_cinema names the film movement, not German nationality or new-wave music. The British and Czechoslovak New Wave choices likewise require the artistic affiliation, not country or release decade alone.

conversion: Vector order, rubrics and definitions retain similarity-v2.3. Do not relabel old full fingerprints as draft.9: new attributes require assessment. Earlier empty or other categorical results do not establish absence of newly listed choices. Preserve historical raw outputs and their original versions; no automatic conversion is implemented.
no_imputation: Unknown stays null. Present with zero centrality is valid. New keys must not be backfilled with guessed zeros or empty selections.
